item.title: Projects
item.description:
My research projects focus on applying Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Remote Sensing to solve real-world challenges in agriculture, environmental monitoring, and healthcare.

🐐 Video-Based Goat Pregnancy Detection and Pregnancy Stage Estimation

Status: Ongoing (M.Sc. Research)

Research Area: Computer Vision • Deep Learning • Video Analytics

Overview

This research aims to develop an intelligent video-based monitoring system capable of detecting pregnant goats, estimating pregnancy stages, and continuously monitoring livestock through computer vision techniques.

item.title: Publications
item.description:
This page provides an overview of my published research and ongoing academic work.

Journal Articles

Image-Based Detection Framework of Freshwater Fish Disease Using Deep Learning

Authors

Umme Habiba et al.

Research Area

Deep Learning • Computer Vision • Image Classification

Summary

This research presents a deep learning-based framework for automated freshwater fish disease detection using convolutional neural networks. Several pre-trained models were evaluated to identify the most effective architecture for disease classification.

item.title: Research
item.description:
My research focuses on the application of Artificial Intelligence to real-world challenges. I am particularly interested in developing data-driven and intelligent systems for agriculture, environmental monitoring, computer vision, and sustainable development.

Research Focus

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

I am interested in designing machine learning solutions that can analyze complex data, identify meaningful patterns, and support accurate decision-making in practical applications.

Deep Learning and Computer Vision

My work explores deep learning techniques for image and video analysis, including object detection, classification, tracking, behavior analysis, and visual monitoring.

item.title: Teaching
item.description:
Teaching is an integral part of my academic career. I strive to create a learning environment where students develop strong theoretical foundations while gaining practical problem-solving skills through real-world applications.

Teaching Philosophy

I believe that effective teaching combines conceptual understanding with hands-on practice. My goal is to encourage curiosity, analytical thinking, and continuous learning while preparing students to address real-world challenges using computing technologies.
